title: 奥尼尔变身信用教授：校园巡回开讲信用知识，四校学生能学会吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We're here with Shaquille O'Neal, of course, the NBA Hall of Famer, television sports analyst.
segments.zh: 今天我们请到了沙奎尔·奥尼尔，NBA名人堂成员，体育评论员。

segments.en: But now, an ambassador, a brand ambassador for Credit One banks, and a, quote, unquote, credit professor.
segments.zh: 现在他是第一信贷银行的大使，也是“信贷教授”。

segments.en: Shaq, you've been involved in a lot of businesses. This one is certainly a little bit different.
segments.zh: 沙克，你涉足过很多行业，这次有点不同。

segments.en: And I want to kind of talk about why you sort of felt compelled to jump in something like this.
segments.zh: 我想聊聊你为什么想参与这类活动。

segments.en: I know you've been very candid in the past about some of your own financial issues.
segments.zh: 我知道你过去曾坦诚分享过自己的财务问题。

segments.en: When you first kind of made it into the league and started making a lot of money, then nobody really taught you anything about credit and finance, is that sort of the goal
segments.zh: 当你刚进入联盟赚大钱时，没人教你信贷和财务知识，这是你的初衷吗？

segments.en: here to make up for that? Yeah, I'm kind of stepping up to the stage as a credit professor for Credit One Bank.
segments.zh: 是的，我现在作为第一信贷银行的信贷教授上台。

segments.en: We're doing a credit tip off tour. I'm going to be hitting four campuses this fall.
segments.zh: 我们正在开展信贷教育巡讲，今年秋天将访问四所大学。

segments.en: SMU, Georgia State, Fred's Barn, Baton Rouge, and Florida Atlantic.
segments.zh: 包括南卫理公会大学、佐治亚州立大学、巴吞鲁日分校和佛罗里达大西洋大学。

segments.en: And we're going to talk about credit education. And it has some good games, have some fun, and then close it out by making people dance.
segments.zh: 我们会讨论信贷教育，玩游戏，最后让大家跳舞。

segments.en: Well, go ahead. Well, give me a sense of what you're going to tell these kids.
segments.zh: 好，请讲。给我讲讲你会跟这些孩子们说什么。

segments.en: I mean, because I've seen a survey from Credit One themselves where they talk about 80% of a lot of young card holders don't really understand the magnitude of missing
segments.zh: 我见过Credit One自己的调查，说很多年轻持卡人中有80%并不真正理解错过还款的严重性。

segments.en: a payment. And there are a lot of folks like that. You get into college.
segments.zh: 有很多这样的人。你进入大学。

segments.en: It's very easy to get a credit card, not so easy, necessarily, to pay it back.
segments.zh: 办信用卡很容易，但还清可不一定容易。

segments.en: Yeah, well, we're going to get into real questions about credit.
segments.zh: 是的，我们会深入探讨关于信贷的真实问题。

segments.en: We're messing people up. I've got some credit record tips and what to avoid.
segments.zh: 我们正在把人搞糊涂。我有一些信用记录方面的建议和要避免的坑。
